quotes.text: the LLM achieved near-perfect alignment with the human consensus (e.g., 100.00% for Diagnosis Accuracy and 96.00% for Rubric Hit Ratio)

parsed.rationale: The benchmark validates its own GPT-4o judge against three-physician consensus on 100 sampled instances per metric, with agreement percentages and an MAE for counting. Supplementary Table 1 reports figures, including a low 62% agreement for one physician on the rubric metric.
